title: Security Response Accelerator: SLA-backed Credit Bundles for Expedited SIG/CAIQ and One-page Attestations
creator: Aisha Kumar
description:
Problem: Large enterprise deals often stall during due diligence because customers need rapid, reliable security answers (SIG/CAIQ sections or one-page attestation summaries). Current signal: sales + solutions engineers spend hours assembling bespoke evidence; legal/infosec teams prioritize but turnaround time is inconsistent. Hypothesis: Offering a paid, SLA-backed "Security Response Accelerator" credit product (digital credit bundles) that combines prioritized queueing, a pre-vetted one-page signed attestation, and expedited SIG/CAIQ answer assembly will reduce sales cycle time and increase conversion for mid-to-large enterprise customers.

What we're building: a purchasable credit bundle available in Console and via Sales/Invoices. Each credit provides: (a) 72-hour guaranteed turnaround for completed SIG/CAIQ sections or a compact signed one-page attestation, (b) automated assembly of evidence from our attestation library and system logs, (c) cryptographically-signed PDF output with audit metadata (who requested, approver, key id, timestamp), (d) optional live Q&A slot with Solutions Engineering for high-touch customers. Bundles are tiered: Accelerator Lite (5 credits, 72h non-priority), Accelerator Fast (3 credits, 48h SLA), Accelerator Enterprise (1-credit fast lane + live SE slot + audit pack). Credits are single-use and tied to an account.

Why unique: This couples a monetizable product with operational SLAs and clear auditability (signed artifacts) instead of free-form manual responses. It reduces variable labor burden on SE/legal teams by templating responses and funnels high-priority work through a defined execution pathway.

Scope for pilot: Console UX for purchasing credits, API to submit an "accelerator request" (attach questionnaire sections), backend queue with SLA counters, automated assembly pipeline (template selection, evidence lookup, PDF signing), billing metering, and simple admin dashboard for tracking outstanding accelerator tasks. Excludes a full SIG/CAIQ auto-answerer in pilot — we'll support assembly + human review.

Assumptions: There are at least three customers willing to pay for faster turnaround; Solutions Engineering/legal can operate the human review lane within SLA; we can produce a defensible one-page attestation acceptable to customers/legal.
acceptance_criteria: Product: Console purchase flow and API endpoint for creating accelerator requests implemented and tested
Legal: One-page attestation template and standard language approved by Legal and Security
Engineering: Backend queue metrics, SLA enforcement, and PDF signing pipeline deployed to staging
Billing: Metering of credit consumption and invoices correctly reflect bundle purchases
Operations: Playbook for SE/human review with estimated SLO workloads and on-call rotations documented
Pilot: At least 3 enterprise customers complete accelerator purchases and we measure time-to-response reduction >= 30% vs baseline
success_metrics: Mean time-to-complete security questionnaire sections or attestation (baseline -> pilot): target 30% reduction
Number of accelerator purchases during 8-week pilot: target >= 5 paying customers
Deal conversion impact: measure change in close-window for deals where accelerator used (target reduction in days)
SE time saved on bespoke assembly per request (target >= 2 hours/request)
Customer satisfaction (post-delivery CSAT) >= 4.2/5 for accelerator deliveries
rollout_plan: Week 1-2: Finalize template language and legal signoff; define operational RACI
Week 3: Implement console purchase flow and billing metering (billing + finance review)
Week 4: Build backend queue, SLA monitor, and PDF signing pipeline (staging)
Week 5: Integrate human review workflow and train 4 SE/legal reviewers; create runbook
Week 6: Run internal closed pilot with 2 sales-led customers; iterate on templates and timing
Week 7-8: External pilot with 3 paying enterprise customers; collect metrics and feedback
Post-pilot: Decide 90-day roadmap (scale, automation of SIG/CAIQ auto-answers, pricing adjustments)
risks_mitigation: Risk: Legal/security template rejected by customers — Mitigation: provision for custom addendum and SE-assisted edits
Risk: SE bandwidth bottleneck causes SLA misses — Mitigation: reserve 'rotating' reviewers and limit concurrent live slots; add surge credits
Risk: Billing disputes for credit consumption — Mitigation: provide transparent audit trail per credit with timestamps and deliverable artifacts
Risk: Signed attestation misinterpreted as standing guarantee — Mitigation: clear language + acceptance criteria in PDF; Legal to vet disclaimers
